items.en: Ukraine unveils home-built 'Koral' air-defense missile with claimed anti-ballistic role at MSPO 2026

items.en: HUR: Russia failed to substitute Western chips in the Kinzhal missile and reverted to US-made processors
items.nl: HUR: Rusland slaagde er niet in westerse chips in de Kinzjal-raket te vervangen en keerde terug naar Amerikaanse processoren

items.en: Ukraine's Defence Intelligence discloses 155 Ruselectronics enterprises supplying components for Russian weapons
items.nl: Oekraïense militaire inlichtingendienst onthult 155 Roselektronika-bedrijven die componenten voor Russische wapens leveren
items.sEn: Ukraine's Defence Intelligence (HUR) has published data on 155 enterprises that are part of, or managed by, the Ruselectronics (Roselektronika) holding, a subsidiary of Russia's state corporation Rostec. items.en: Ukraine's foreign intelligence: European NATO members may be a 'second target' of Russia's winter missile buildup
items.nl: Oekraïense buitenlandse inlichtingendienst: Europese NAVO-landen mogelijk 'tweede doelwit' van Russische winter-rakettenopbouw
items.sEn: Ukraine's Foreign Intelligence Service (SZRU) has warned that European NATO members may become a "second target" of Russia's winter missile buildup, alongside primary strikes on Ukraine's critical infrastructure and power grid.
